articles.serializers module

class articles.serializers.ArticleSerializer(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelSerializer

Serializer for approved article data exposed through the REST API. Converts Article model instances into JSON-friendly representations. Related author, publisher, and category objects are represented using their string values rather than primary keys.

Variables:

  • author (StringRelatedField) – String representation of the article author.

  • publisher (StringRelatedField) – String representation of the publisher.

  • category (StringRelatedField) – String representation of the category.
